card.name: Capitalized word just before plural S
card.fires_on: The last piece of an ALL-CAPS noun when only a plural 'S' is still to come, as in FL-UID-S, PER-IOD-S, CONTRAIND-ICATION-S. Seen in capitalized warning text in drug labels.

modes.label: Split word before S
modes.description: A capitalized word broken so the next piece is the plural S.

modes.label: Whole capitalized noun
modes.description: A full capitalized noun at the end of a phrase, before a plural or following text.
modes.example: GREATER VARIABILITY OF<< RESPONSE>> IN THIS AGE GROUP.

card.writes: It favors starting a new word or a foreign-language word and suppresses endings like s, ing, ed, so it blocks adding a suffix.
card.plain: It fires on capitalized label words that are nearly finished, where only a plural S is left.
